correctness.rationale: For y^3=f(x)=x^5+a x^3+x in characteristic 7, f is squarefree iff a²≠4; tame degree-three cover has six fully ramified branch points and genus four. The involution (x,y)↦(-x,-y) has two fixed points and genus-two quotient; +/- eigendifferentials have dimensions two. Direct integer polynomial convolution independently reproduces the Cartier seventh-power invariant diagonal (a²+2,(a²+2)(a²−4)) and anti-invariant [[4a,1],[1,4a]]; determinant 2(a²−4) in F7 is nonzero throughout the smooth locus. Degree-two prime-to-7 Prym/quotient isogeny preserves p-rank, so Prym is ordinary, Q ordinary except zero Cartier at a²=−2 (then genus-two superspecial), yielding ranks 4/2 and no intermediate values. The two exceptional ±a curves are isomorphic after scaling x by c with c²=−1 and y by d with d³=c. The source verification arithmetic over F49 is corroborative, not a proof for all k-points.
